kpis.description_fr: Crédits net à la clientèle Italie + Croatie. Modèle banque commerciale + lease + factoring.
kpis.description_en: Customer net loans Italy + Croatia. Commercial bank + lease + factoring model.

kpis.description_fr: CET1 ratio (capital adequacy). Plus haut que peers italiens. Marge sécurité régulatoire.
kpis.description_en: CET1 ratio (capital adequacy). Higher than Italian peers. Regulatory safety margin.

kpis.description_fr: Cost-Income en baisse rapide (operating leverage). Best-in-class peers italiens (vs ~55%).
kpis.description_en: Cost-Income declining fast (operating leverage). Best-in-class Italian peers (vs ~55%).

kpis.description_fr: NPE gross. Asset quality excellent. Largement sous régulateur threshold + Italie average (~3%).
kpis.description_en: Gross NPE. Excellent asset quality. Well below regulator threshold + Italian average (~3%).

kpis.description_fr: Net sales wealth/private banking. Pillar diversification fee income. Stratégie post-Bertelsmann CEO 2024.
kpis.description_en: Wealth/private banking net sales. Diversification pillar fee income. Post-Bertelsmann CEO 2024 strategy.

kpis_story.description_fr: Offre publique Mediocredito Centrale 2025 (consolidation Italie). Wave M&A banque italienne attendue.
kpis_story.description_en: Mediocredito Centrale 2025 takeover bid (Italian consolidation). Italian banking M&A wave expected.

kpis_story.description_fr: Acquisition Banca Intesa Croatia 2023 (€255M). Synergies digital banking + cross-border wealth integrate. Premier banque Croatie 2024.
kpis_story.description_en: Banca Intesa Croatia acquisition 2023 (€255M). Digital banking + cross-border wealth integration synergies. #1 Croatian bank 2024.

_notes: FBK.MI = Fineco Bank (probably) Italian online bank. Modèle digital wealth-focused + low cost-income.
